name: Afterglow
thesis: Raygen’s work fills a deep phosphor display that feels like a personal instrument for looking closely at things he has made.
interaction: Switch the display between SERV0, DAVID, and Stardance, or remove SERV0’s panels to inspect the aligned internal assembly; a single scan reveal marks each project change.
why: The centered, oversized printer and direct physical inspection give the laboratory-screen language a real purpose, while warm personal writing and Raygen’s cat avatar keep the engineer visibly present.
